description: A 16:9 diagram with three side-by-side rounded columns of equal width under one wide rounded box at the top labelled 'MCP server: rasoi-toolbox (Kavita's Bahi session)'. Column 1 header 'Tools', sub-header 'the model decides when', two small boxes inside: 'check_stock' and 'create_purchase_request'. Column 2 header 'Resources', sub-header 'the app decides what to attach', two small boxes inside: 'rasoi://policy/purchase' and 'rasoi://stock/{item_code}'. Column 3 header 'Prompts', sub-header 'the person picks one', one small box inside: 'raise_a_pr (item, quantity, need_by)'. Under each column one short grey line of text: under Tools 'tools/list, tools/call'; under Resources 'resources/list, resources/read'; under Prompts 'prompts/list, prompts/get'. Columns in soft sky blue, the top server box white with a sky-blue border. Labels as plain text, no brackets except in the resource names and the prompt arguments exactly as written.

A 16:9 comparison diagram split into two equal panels side by side, each a vertical sequence of message arrows between a left column 'Client' and a right column 'Server'. Left panel title 'Handshake era (2025-11-25)' in grey. Its arrows top to bottom: 'initialize' (client to server), 'result: version, capabilities' (server to client), 'notifications/initialized' (client to server), 'tools/call create_purchase_request' (client to server), 'elicitation/create: confirm?' (server to client, highlighted in ember orange), 'answer: accept' (client to server), 'result: PR/2026/04417' (server to client). A small note at the bottom of the left panel: 'one session, the server holds state'. Right panel title 'Stateless (2026-07-28)' in sky blue. Its arrows: 'server/discover' (client to server, dashed, labelled optional), 'tools/call + version and capabilities in _meta' (client to server), 'input_required: confirm? + signed requestState' (server to client, highlighted sky blue), 'retry tools/call + answer + requestState' (client to server), 'result: PR/2026/04417' (server to client). Note at the bottom of the right panel: 'every request stands alone'. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A 16:9 sequence diagram with four vertical lifelines from left to right: 'Kavita (browser)', 'MCP client (host)', 'Rasoi toolbox (MCP server)', 'Rasoi sign-in (authorization server)'. Numbered arrows top to bottom: '1 POST /mcp, no token' (client to toolbox); '2 401 + where to sign in' (toolbox to client); '3 GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource' (client to toolbox); '4 GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server' (client to sign-in); '5 register the client' (client to sign-in); '6 sign in and consent, PKCE' (Kavita to sign-in, through the browser); '7 code' (sign-in to client); '8 code + verifier for a token' (client to sign-in); '9 access token: sub KJOSHI, scope, audience = toolbox' (sign-in to client); '10 POST /mcp + Bearer token' (client to toolbox); '11 tools run in Kavita's own Bahi session' (a short note box on the toolbox lifeline, sky blue). Arrows 1 to 5 grey, 6 to 9 green, 10 and 11 sky blue. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A 16:9 diagram. In the centre a rounded box 'Host: Ask Rasoi' containing a smaller box 'LLM'. On the right, two MCP server boxes stacked: top 'rasoi-toolbox (trusted)', bottom 'supplier directory (third party)' with an ember-orange border. Below the host, a box 'Bahi ERP'. Four numbered ember-orange callouts placed around the picture, each with a short attack name and, beneath it in sky blue, its defence: callout 1 next to the third-party server's arrow into the host: 'Tool poisoning: hidden orders in a tool description' / 'pin and review tool descriptions'; callout 2 next to a document arrow from the third-party server: 'Injection in tool output: a quote that gives orders' / 'treat results as data; confirm writes'; callout 3 next to the toolbox: 'Confused deputy: a server that runs as SVC_AGENT' / 'bind each server to the signed-in user'; callout 4 next to a key icon on the arrow from host to toolbox: 'Over-broad scope: a token that can do everything' / 'least scope per agent'. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A 16:9 diagram of two companies side by side, each inside a large rounded rectangle with a title. Left rectangle title 'Rasoi Steel Works, Pune'. Inside it, top: a box 'Ask Rasoi (agent)'; below it, connected by a vertical arrow labelled 'MCP', a box 'Rasoi toolbox'; below that, connected by a vertical line, an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2'. Right rectangle title 'Deccan Polymers, Rajkot'. Inside it, top: a box 'Deccan sales agent'; below it, connected by a vertical arrow labelled 'its own tools', a box 'stock, prices, dispatch'. A thick horizontal sky-blue double arrow joins 'Ask Rasoi (agent)' and 'Deccan sales agent' across the gap between the two companies, labelled 'A2A: agent to agent'. A thin dashed vertical line in the gap labelled 'company boundary'. Under the left company a caption 'MCP: an agent uses tools'; under the right a caption 'A2A: an agent asks another agent'. Labels as plain text, no brackets except '(agent)'.

A 16:9 diagram with four panels in a row, left to right, joined by thin arrows. Panel 1 'Agent card' shaped like a card: lines 'name: Deccan Polymers sales agent', 'url: /a2a', 'skills: quote, delivery date, confirm order', 'capabilities: streaming'; small text under it 'GET /.well-known/agent-card.json'. Panel 2 'Message': lines 'role: user', 'parts: text', 'parts: data'. Panel 3 'Task': a small state line with four rounded chips 'submitted', 'working', 'input required', 'completed'; under it 'artifacts: the quote'. Panel 4 'Streaming': three stacked event strips 'status update: working', 'artifact update: quote', 'status update: completed'. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A 16:9 diagram. Top row: a horizontal chain of eight small rounded node boxes joined by arrows, labelled exactly: 'Webhook', 'Check stock', 'Raise the PR', 'Ask Rohit', 'Wait for Rohit', 'Order from Deccan', 'Release', 'Tell Rohit'. Above the chain a grey label 'n8n workflow (self-hosted)'. The 'Wait for Rohit' node is green; the six others after Webhook have a small tag 'MCP Client'. Below the chain, one wide rounded sky-blue box 'Rasoi toolbox over streamable HTTP: /kavita/mcp and /rohit/mcp'; vertical arrows go down from each tagged node to this box. Below that an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2'. On the right side, a separate small box 'Rohit approves (his own session)' with an arrow into the toolbox box and a dashed arrow back to 'Wait for Rohit' labelled 'resume'. Labels as plain text, no brackets.

A 16:9 architecture diagram. In the centre a large rounded sky-blue box 'Rasoi toolbox: MCP server' containing small chips 'tools', 'resources', 'prompts'. Under it an ember-orange box 'Bahi ERP 7.2 (1998)'. To the left, a vertical stack of four host boxes each with an arrow into the toolbox labelled 'MCP': 'Ask Rasoi', 'Claude Desktop', 'VS Code and Cursor', 'n8n workflows'. Above the toolbox a green strip 'sign-in: OAuth 2.1 token, Kavita's own session'. To the right of 'Ask Rasoi', a long horizontal sky-blue double arrow labelled 'A2A' going to a box at the far right 'Deccan Polymers sales agent', which sits inside a dashed rectangle titled 'another company'. Labels as plain text, no brackets except '(1998)'.
